title: library coordinate system schema
description: How a position on the piece is read: origin, axis directions, units. After SEMI M20 (wafer coordinate system) and SEMI E142 (substrate map origin and axis direction); NeXus NXcoordinate_system.

origin.description: Where the origin is, as a physical feature of the piece, e.g. wafer corner

corner.description: Which corner the origin is at, seen with the film face up, e.g. lower-left; null until the lab states it

xDirection.description: Direction x increases in, seen with the film face up, e.g. right; null until the lab states it

yDirection.description: Direction y increases in, seen with the film face up, e.g. up; null until the lab states it
